about: Reference answers from the team's sklearn index (SpinOff_AI feedback_knn.pkl) with the rule of amir_pipeline._get_tip: Q rows are [type index, speed, spin, angle, quality] (from knn_testvec.json, rounded to 4 decimals) and ref is the tip _get_tip returns. ties are the 4 queries of knn_testvec.json where sklearn and the JS port pick different tips at exactly the same distance, as [type index, speed, spin, angle, quality, ref]. kicks rows are firmware-shaped kicks [firmware type, speedMph, spinRPM, launchAngle, strikeQuality, the 5 nearest tips] and named holds the kicks the browser test sends.
